name: Blood Hawk
sourceWitness: Read the local original Wizards of the Coast Adventurers League module . The and printed folio numbers match for these pages. The publisher’s adventure index confirms the title and adventure code.
errataEvidence: The official Adventurers League FAQ adventure errata does not list this adventure.
appearanceEvidence: Editorial description of the reused portrait at beast-ready-batch-04/parts/b04_02/portraits/blood-hawk.png.
habitatEvidence: The tower and Elemental Plane of Air are explicit on p. 10.
printingNotes: The cover dates the release April 1, 2015.
The Monster/NPC Statistics appendix gives a complete Beast block. The summoning provenance on p. 10 adds no traits or creature-type changes.

name: Giant Badger
sourceWitness: Read the local original Wizards of the Coast Adventurers League module . The and printed folio numbers match for these pages. The publisher’s adventure index confirms the title and adventure code.
errataEvidence: The official Adventurers League FAQ adventure errata does not list this adventure.
appearanceEvidence: Shared Batch 15 obsidian Giant Badger portrait. The black teeth and claws follow City of Danger p. 22. The shared portrait’s faint opalescent eyes reflect the DDEP2 encounter description.
habitatEvidence: p. 22 places the beasts in the mine and its tunnels.

name: Giant Badger
sourceWitness: Read the local original Wizards of the Coast Adventurers League module . The and printed folio numbers match for these pages. The publisher’s adventure index confirms the title and adventure code.
errataEvidence: The official Adventurers League FAQ corrects the adventure’s per-character XP minimum and maximum from 450–600 on p. 18 to 900–1,200. Its erratum leaves the printed per-creature XP and creature mechanics intact.
appearanceEvidence: Editorial description of the reused portrait at beast-ready-batch-04/parts/b04_04/portraits/giant-badger.png.
habitatEvidence: The Flooded Forest and the underground grotto are the adventure locations described on pp. 14–15.
printingNotes: The cover dates the release May 1, 2015. Its level 5–10 cover blurb conflicts with the interior and the official adventure index’s 1–4 scope.
The p. 22 stat block and p. 18 combat award both give 50 XP. The grotto badger’s tactics appear on p. 15.
